title: 第13章 任家有难第14章 怪异花朵疑云丛生
slug: 九叔系统道术给我全加满
content_zh:
“收！”
林凡慌忙收起剑指，眼中跃动精光！
这才叫紫霄神雷！
这才叫传说中的雷霆！
这已经不是简单的增幅几倍的问题了！
此刻的紫霄神雷，宛若身躯一般，随意操纵。
和寻常五雷咒，引天雷进攻的匮乏不同。
紫霄神雷乃千变万化，宛若先天境界的气息一般，随心而动。
“这也太夸张了，要是全力施展，再加上桃木剑的增幅，这还得了？”
林凡满面春风，长舒了口气。
“系统，打开属性面板。”
姓名：林凡
境界：后天九重天
法器：桃木剑（道术增幅100%）
道法：紫霄神雷（大圆满）、锁魂驱邪符（小成）、清心符（大圆满）、开眼术（大圆满）
功德值：20
技能点：4541
……
“一般般猛吧，再接再厉。”
林凡站起身来，伸了个懒腰。

等等技能点，提升一下锁魂驱邪符，又是一大截提升。
再等等功德，升级了清心符和开眼术，那就真叫无敌了！
嘭！
忽然，门外响起一道爆破声。
“嗯？”
林凡迅速跃起，朝往外赶去。
只见那爆破声响处，竟是停放着任太爷的长生屋处传来的！
文才不是在长生屋中睡觉么？
怎么会闹出这么大动静？
九叔的身影浮现在院子之中，疾驰向林玄，担心道：“没事吧？”
“师父，我没事，赶紧去长生屋看看！”
“走！”
九叔二话不说，领着林玄往长生屋方向去。
两人刚踏入长生屋，顿时都停住了脚。
只见房内任老太爷的棺木，墨斗线已全然毁坏。
棺盖早已被人打开，尸首不翼而飞。
角落还瘫软着一个灰头土脸的身影，正瑟瑟发抖念叨着什么。
“文才，文才！”
九叔先一步上前，拍了拍文才。
“别杀我！我什么都不知道！我什么都不知道！”

文才吓得哆嗦，连连摇手喊了起来。
“呆子，是我和师父！”
林凡见文才没事，这才拽了拽他说道。
content_en:
"Take it!"
Lin Fan hurriedly put away his sword finger, his eyes flashing with light!
This is called Zixiao Divine Thunder!
This is called the legendary Thunder!
This is no longer a simple matter of increasing the rate several times!
At this moment, Zixiao Divine Thunder is like a body and can be manipulated at will.
Unlike the ordinary Five Thunder Curse, it is different from the lack of attracting sky thunder to attack.
The purple sky divine thunder is ever-changing, just like the breath of the innate realm, moving according to the heart.
"This is too exaggerated. If you use it with all your strength, plus the increase of Taomu Sword, is it still possible?"
Lin Fan's face was filled with joy and he breathed a long sigh of relief.
"System, open the properties panel."
Name: Lin Fan
Realm: the ninth level of the day after tomorrow
Magical weapon: Peach wood sword (Taoist skills increased by 100%)
Taoism: Purple Sky Divine Thunder (Dzogchen), Soul-Locking Exorcist Talisman (Xiao Cheng), Pure Heart Talisman (Dzogchen), Eye-Opening Technique (Dzogchen)
Merit value: 20
Skill points: 4541
…
"Just be as fierce as usual and keep up the good work."
Lin Fan stood up and stretched.
Wait for skill points and upgrade the Soul Locking Exorcism Talisman, which will be another big improvement.
If you wait for merit and upgrade the Pure Heart Talisman and Eye Opening Technique, you will be truly invincible!
Bang!
Suddenly, there was a blast outside the door.
"Huh?"
Lin Fan quickly jumped up and rushed out.
I saw that the sound of explosions came from the place where Mr. Ren’s longevity house was parked!
Didn't Wen Cai sleep in the House of Immortality?
How could there be such a big fuss?
Uncle Jiu's figure appeared in the yard, galloping towards Lin Xuan, worriedly asking: "Are you okay?"
"Master, I'm fine, go to the House of Immortality quickly and take a look!"
"Let's go!"
Without saying a word, Uncle Jiu led Lin Xuan towards the Changsheng House.
As soon as the two of them stepped into the Changsheng House, they immediately stopped.
I saw old man Ren's coffin in the room, and the ink lines had been completely destroyed.
The coffin lid had been opened long ago, and the body was missing.
There was a gray-faced figure slumped in the corner, trembling and mumbling something.
"Literary talent, literary talent!"
Uncle Jiu stepped forward first and patted Wencai.
"Don't kill me! I don't know anything! I don't know anything!"
Wencai trembled with fright, waved his hands and shouted.
"Idiot, it's me and Master!"
Lin Fan saw that Wen Cai was fine, so he pulled him and said.
